claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament officially begins with honorary starters at 7:25 a.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
John Keefer and Haotong Li are the first competitive pairing at 7:40 a.m. ET in the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
The opening rounds (Thursday and Friday) of the 2026 Masters Tournament feature groups teeing off in 10-12 minute intervals from 7:40 a.m. ET to roughly 1:45 p.m. ET.
Honorary Starters (Nicklaus, Player, Watson) tee off at 7:25 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
John Keefer, Haotong Li tee off at 7:40 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Naoyuki Kataoka, Max Homa, Carlos Ortiz tee off at 7:50 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Dustin Johnson, Shane Lowry, Jason Day tee off at 9:43 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Bryson DeChambeau, Matt Fitzpatrick, Xander Schauffele tee off at 10:07 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Rory McIlroy, Cameron Young, Mason Howell (A) tee off at 10:31 a.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Jordan Spieth, Justin Rose, Brooks Koepka tee off at 1:20 p.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
Scottie Scheffler, Robert MacIntyre, Gary Woodland tee off at 1:44 p.m. ET in the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9.
